params:
  appraiser_name: ""

---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE,
                      fig.width = 8, fig.height = 5)

# Try to load pre-computed assets from plot_dir
.assets <- NULL
.plots_dir <- params$plot_dir
data_file <- file.path(.plots_dir, "report_data.rds")
if (file.exists(data_file)) {
  .assets <- readRDS(data_file)
  .plots_dir <- file.path(dirname(data_file), "plots")
}

include_plot <- function(name, width = 8, height = 5) {
  for (ext in c("png", "pdf")) {
    f <- file.path(.plots_dir, paste0(name, ".", ext))
    if (file.exists(f)) {
      cat(sprintf("![](%s)\n\n", f))
      return(invisible(NULL))
    }
  }
}
```

```{r dataset-desc, results='asis', eval=!is.null(.assets)}
cat("## Dataset Description\n\n")
cat("| Property | Value |\n|----------|-------|\n")
cat(sprintf("| Data file | %s |\n", .assets$data_file_name))
cat(sprintf("| Observations | %d |\n", .assets$n_obs))
cat(sprintf("| Response variable | %s |\n", .assets$response))
cat(sprintf("| Predictors | %s |\n", paste(.assets$predictors, collapse = ", ")))
cat(sprintf("| Purpose | %s |\n", .assets$purpose))
```

```{r model-spec, results='asis', eval=!is.null(.assets)}
cat("\n## Model Specification\n\n")
cat("| Parameter | Value |\n|-----------|-------|\n")
cat(sprintf("| Alpha | %s |\n", .assets$alpha))
cat(sprintf("| Lambda | %s |\n", signif(.assets$lambda, 5)))
cat(sprintf("| Lambda selection | %s |\n", .assets$lambda_method))
cat(sprintf("| Family | %s |\n", .assets$family))
cat(sprintf("| Standardize | %s |\n", .assets$standardize))
cat(sprintf("| Relaxed | %s |\n", .assets$relaxed))
cat(sprintf("| Non-zero coefficients | %d |\n", .assets$n_nonzero))
cat(sprintf("| Total predictors | %d |\n", .assets$n_predictors))
```

```{r results-summary, results='asis', eval=!is.null(.assets)}
cat("\n## Results Summary\n\n")
cat("| Metric | Value |\n|--------|-------|\n")
cat(sprintf("| R² | %.4f |\n", .assets$r_squared))
cat(sprintf("| Adjusted R² | %.4f |\n", .assets$adj_r_squared))
cat(sprintf("| Generalized R² | %.4f |\n", .assets$gen_r_squared))
cvr2 <- if (!is.na(.assets$cv_r_squared)) sprintf("%.4f", .assets$cv_r_squared) else "N/A"
cat(sprintf("| CV R² | %s |\n", cvr2))
cat(sprintf("| RMSE | %.2f |\n", .assets$rmse))
cat(sprintf("| MAE | %.2f |\n", .assets$mae))
```

```{r equation, results='asis', eval=!is.null(.assets)}
cat("\n## Model Equation\n\n")
cat("$$\n", .assets$equation_latex, "\n$$\n")
```

## Coefficients

```{r coef-table}
coef_df <- if (!is.null(.assets)) .assets$coef_df else params$coef_df
if (!is.null(coef_df)) {
  knitr::kable(coef_df, digits = 4)
}
```

```{r importance, results='asis', eval=!is.null(.assets) && nrow(.assets$importance_df) > 0}
cat("\n## Variable Importance\n\n")
```

```{r importance-plot, results='asis', eval=!is.null(.assets)}
include_plot("importance")
```

```{r importance-table, eval=!is.null(.assets) && nrow(.assets$importance_df) > 0}
knitr::kable(.assets$importance_df, digits = 4)
```

```{r contributions, results='asis', eval=!is.null(.assets)}
cat("\n## Contributions\n\n")
contrib_names <- .assets$contrib_names
for (vname in contrib_names) {
  safe_name <- gsub("[^a-zA-Z0-9_]", "_", vname)
  cat(sprintf("\n### %s\n\n", vname))
  is_int <- grepl(":", vname, fixed = TRUE)
  if (is_int) {
    include_plot(paste0("contrib_", safe_name, "_scatter"))
    include_plot(paste0("contrib_", safe_name, "_heatmap"))
    include_plot(paste0("contrib_", safe_name, "_3d"))
  } else {
    include_plot(paste0("contrib_", safe_name))
  }
  cat("\n\n")
}
```

```{r correlation-heading, results='asis', eval=!is.null(.assets)}
cat("\n## Correlation Matrix\n\n")
```

```{r correlation-plot, results='asis', eval=!is.null(.assets)}
include_plot("correlation")
```

```{r anova, results='asis', eval=!is.null(.assets) && nrow(.assets$anova_df) > 0}
cat("\n## ANOVA Decomposition\n\n")
knitr::kable(.assets$anova_df, digits = 2)
```
